definitions.explanation: A substance applied to metal to keep it from rusting or corroding. It comes as sprays, oils, and coatings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{防錆|ぼうせい}{剤|ざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧。
examples.english: I apply rust preventative to the metal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チェーン→チェーン：08833_cheen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{防錆|ぼうせい}{剤|ざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦スプレー→スプレー：11581_supuree⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I sprayed rust preventative on the bicycle chain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{錆|さ}び→錆びる：07412_sabiru⟧やすい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下回|したまわ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{防錆|ぼうせい}{剤|ざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{施|ほどこ}した→施す：12985_hodokosu⟧。
examples.english: Things rust easily near the sea, so I applied rust preventative to the underbody of the car.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{防錆|ぼうせい}→防錆：20879_bousei⟧ (rust prevention) + ⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧ (agent, preparation). The suffix ⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧ forms the names of chemical agents and preparations.
